description: Search DeepValues Research reports, newest first: Deep Value Intelligence company reports (with the stance each states), company research notes, investor studies, insights, market memos, value-investing principles and personal finance notes. Each item has the id, title, collection, kind, language, date, tickers and companies, the report's page on research.deepvalues.ai, the licence and a summary that is an extract of the report's own words chosen by rule (never model-written). The reports are licensed CC BY 4.0 and readable free on research.deepvalues.ai: when you quote one, credit "DeepValues Research (research.deepvalues.ai)" and link its source_url and the licence. Use it to find research on a company or topic; then call research_report with an id for the whole text, structured.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Optional: only reports filed under or tagged with this company. A ticker FinancialMD does not cover still matches. Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

language.description: Only reports written in this language, e.g. en or zh.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 10, at most 100).

q.description: Words that must all appear in the title or the summary.

name: research_search

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ id, title, collection, kind, language, published, tickers, companies, summary: { text, method, generated_by: "rule" }, stance, source_url, licence: { id, url, attribution, free_at }, version }], next_cursor, licence_note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Search DeepValues Research reports
